samples.ref: Plasma Pharmacokinetics of High-Dose Oral versus Intravenous Rifampicin in Patients with Tuberculous Meningitis:
samples.hyp:
Hausa:
A cikin wannan binciken, an yi amfani da samfurin plasma na jini don tantance yadda magungunan baki da rifampicin ke isa ga jijiyoyin jini a cikin majiyyata masu cutar sankarau na kwakwalwa. An gudanar da binciken ne a asibitin koyarwa na jami’ar Maiduguri, Najeriya, tsakanin watan Janairu zuwa Disamba na shekarar 2018. An tattara samfurin plasma na jini daga majiyyata 10 masu cutar sankarau na kwakwalwa da ke karbar magungunan baki da rifampicin. An yi amfani da hanyar chromatography mai saurin gas don tantance adadin magungunan a cikin plasma. Sakamakon binciken ya nuna cewa adadin magungunan a cikin plasma ya fi yadda ake tsammani. Wannan na iya zama sakamakon canjin da magungunan ke samu a cikin jini, wanda zai iya shafar tasirinsu a jiki. Wannan binciken ya nuna cewa magungunan baki da rifampicin na iya isa ga jijiyoyin jini a cikin majiyyata masu cutar sankarau na kwakwalwa fiye da yadda ake tsammani. Wannan na iya zama dalilin da ya sa magungunan ke da tasiri a jiki, kuma ya kamata a yi la’akari da shi wajen tsara magungunan ga majiyyata masu cutar sankarau na kwakwalwa.
English:
In this study, plasma samples were used to determine the extent of penetration of antibiotics and rifampicin into the bloodstream in patients with meningitis. The study was conducted at the University of Maiduguri Teaching Hospital, Nigeria, between January and December 2018. Plasma samples were collected from 10 patients with meningitis who were receiving antibiotics and rifampicin. High-performance liquid chromatography was used to determine the concentrations of the drugs in the plasma.
